feedback.content:
Both the typecheck and the relevant test suites pass (27 tests, 2 suites, no failures; only pre-existing `act()` console warnings unrelated to this change). The implementation matches the task exactly:

- `electron/main.cjs`: `ipcMain.handle('poster:pick-library-folder', ...)` uses `dialog.showOpenDialog` with `openDirectory`/`createDirectory`, bound to the calling window.
- `electron/preload.cjs`: exposes `pickLibraryFolder` on `window.poster` via `contextBridge`.
- `src/HomePage.tsx`: `changeLibraryRoot` prefers `window.poster.pickLibraryFolder()` when present, falling back to `window.prompt` in the browser.
- `src/Present/SessionTransport.ts`: type declaration updated for the new bridge method.
- Tests: `src/HomePage.unit.test.tsx` asserts the picker is used and `window.prompt` is not called when the bridge is present; `src/__tests__/electron-main.regression.test.js` asserts the IPC handler and preload exposure exist as a regression guard.
